senses.definition: Canaanitish town, with a king, named just before Aphek Jos 12:17, exact site unknown.
1 K 4:10 in Judah (ארץ ח׳);—on גִּ֫תָּה ח׳ Jos 19:13, גַּת הַח׳ 2 K 14:25, v. גַּת sub יגן.
